author: DOC-029 source-review author agent (contracts-b)

corrections.before: Step 1 said to use the 'Renewal pending confirmation' prompt.
corrections.after: The banner reads 'Renewal date passed — pending confirmation' and its button is 'Review renewal' (Member+ writers only). 'Renewal pending confirmation' is only the banner's screen-reader region name.

corrections.before: Step 2 said to choose Confirm the roll 'under How to record it'.
corrections.after: 'How to record it' is a screen-reader-only legend, so no visible heading exists. Confirm the roll is the first and default option.
Uses the CONTEXT.md and Overview label 'Legal Owner'. The create dialog's Owner picker starts Unassigned for a routed renewal and the API copies no Owner.

confirmed: Overview 'Contract' card holds Term type (Fixed term, Auto-renewing, Evergreen), Effective date, Expiry date, Renewal period (months), Notice period (days); each commits on its own.
Evergreen draws Expiry date as a read-only blank; a non-Auto-renewing type draws Renewal period as a read-only blank.
API PATCH clears expiry when retyped to Evergreen and clears renewal period when retyped away from Auto-renewing; it refuses an expiry on Evergreen and a renewal period on non-auto-renew types.
Key dates derived rows are 'Current term expires' and 'Renewal notice deadline — N days before expiry' with source 'Derived' and no row actions; notice deadline = expiry minus notice period.
Term timeline card heading 'Term timeline'; Last renewal fact reads the newest confirmed roll.
Renew button appears on Approvals & signing only when not archived, Member+, Auto-renewing and expiry present; the banner shows only when renewalPendingConfirmation.

Dialog title 'Confirm renewal'; options Confirm the roll, Paper as amendment (only with a primary Document), Create child contract, New successor contract; field 'New expiry date'; buttons Confirm renewal / File the amendment / Open the child contract / Open the successor.
Client and API refuse a new expiry on or before the current expiry ('A roll moves the term forward. Pick a date after the current expiry.').

Confirm carries fromExpiry; a moved expiry answers RENEWAL_EXPIRY_MOVED 409 ('This contract's expiry has already moved. ...'); the page re-reads the record while the dialog keeps the typed draft; reopening reseeds the proposal.
Confirmation updates only expiryDate, records contract.renewal_confirmed, and does not change Status or Stage; Renewals rows show on Approvals & signing.

Paper as amendment navigates to Documents and opens Add version with kind amendment on the primary Document; signing.primaryDocument refreshes only on envelope and executed-copy live events, so the reload advice stays valid.
Routed create copies live Entity, value (amount, currency, cadence), term shape and Counterparties; it copies no Owner, team, Status (Draft), Priority (default medium), Risk or Confidential flag.
Archived record: API editableContract refuses; Contributor gets 403 on the renewal route.
limitations: Source inspection only. The independent V-C18 browser walkthrough at 3fa407e3 is still required.
The amendment composer opens only when the primary Document is in the Documents page the card holds (documents-card.tsx comment); the article does not claim more.

corrections.after: 'the Contract's Legal Owner' (CONTEXT.md; Overview label Legal Owner).

corrections.before: Step 4 implied a completed Task stays in the list after its checkbox is selected.
corrections.after: The Tasks section hides completed Tasks by default; the header switch 'Show completed' shows them. The article now says so.

corrections.before: Step 5 did not say where Edit task and Remove task are.
corrections.after: Both are items in the row's actions menu.
The Add a task dialog posts the initial note and files with the Working team audience; no audience choice exists there.

corrections.before: Assignee picker 'offers active people on the Contract team, including its Owner'.
corrections.after: It offers active non-Business-User people on the team plus the Legal Owner.
Label is now 'Note' (Date and Event carry the required marker).

corrections.before: Usual reminder audience 'the Legal Owner and its team'; recipient list not described.
corrections.after: 'the Legal Owner and the Contract team'; the checkbox list is active team members, never Business Users.

corrections.before: The Key dates list 'identifies the next deadline'.
corrections.after: The UI draws no next-deadline marker. The API sorts upcoming dates nearest first, then past dates; isNext is returned but not rendered.
Next deadline is a Contracts list column; the record page does not show it.

corrections.before: 'Use Use the usual audience' to return to default recipients, as if always available.
corrections.after: That button shows only when a selected recipient has left the team; otherwise clearing all recipient checkboxes returns to the usual audience.

confirmed: Tasks section: Add task button, dialog title 'Add a task', fields Title (required), Description, Assignee, Due date, 'Comments & attachments' with 'Add a note' and file picker; submit 'Add task'; Cancel for new, Close for existing.
Existing Task opens 'Task details' with Save; its thread is the contract_task comment thread without the Full thread tier (Legal only, Working team).
Partial save shows 'Task saved. Your note and attachments could not be added.' and the button becomes 'Retry note & attachments' without creating a second Task.
Done count '{done} of {total} done'; checkbox toggles done and reopen.
Remove refuses 409 when the Task holds any comment row, including deleted or redacted ones.
Picker offers 'Add someone to the team…', then an access notice and 'Add to team and assign'; inside the dialog it offers 'Use this person' and saves membership with the Task.
No reorder control in the Contract Tasks UI; the API reorder route exists only as API.
Tasks read and write are Administrator and Legal Team Member only; Contributors lost Task read in this range; the Portal record view has no Tasks or Key dates.

Key date dialog: Date and Event required, Note, Reminders fieldset with 'Global reminders: …', 'This date will remind: …', 'Additional lead time (days before)', 'Add lead time' (0 to 730, at most 20), Remove per lead time; submit 'Add date' or 'Save'.
Row actions 'Edit date' and 'Remove date' only on Key date rows; Derived rows have no menu.
Reminders: one per Key date with its label; own offsets are unioned with the global list; a saved selection narrows to the current audience and never falls back.
Next deadline: earliest upcoming Key date, unfinished dated Task (including overdue), expiry or notice deadline, null for ended or archived Contracts.
Home sections 'Tasks assigned to you' and 'Dates approaching' exist.
Archived Contract: API answers 409 for Task and Key date writes; UI draws no controls.

Reminder delivery timing was not exercised; notifications.md owns those rules.

corrections.after: The Activity feed opens from the record's 'History' applet; the article now names History.

corrections.before: Archive section did not mention the Matter side.
corrections.after: Since this range the Matter's Linked Contracts list excludes archived Contracts; the article now says an archived Contract is not shown there.

confirmed: Overview holds the 'Matter' card and the 'Related contracts' card with 'Set parent' (only without a parent) and 'Add link'; link types Related, Renews, Amends; reverse labels Renewed by, Amended by; 'Remove parent' and 'Remove link' on rows.

Link dialog search placeholder 'Search by number or title…'; refusals for self-link, duplicate and cycle; nudge 'Flag as confidential?' names which Contract, with 'Flag as confidential' and 'No, leave it open'.
Restricted related records read 'Restricted contract'.
Relation writes are Member+, lock both Contracts, and refuse an archived one with 409; candidates exclude archived Contracts and the anchor.

Matter card: 'Link to Matter' shows only when no Matter is linked; dialog search 'Search by Matter number or title', button 'Link'; 'Unlink' on the linked row; confidentiality mismatch dialog changes neither flag.
Stage pipeline moves the Status; ended Contracts stay editable (frozen is archived or non-Member+ only).
Contracts list 'Filter' menu has 'Show ended' and 'Show archived' flags.
'Contract actions' menu holds 'Archive' or 'Restore' for Member+; archived records show the 'Archived' pill and 'This contract is archived — it is out of the contract list. Restore it to edit.'
Archive and restore change only archivedAt, not Status.
